description:
A developer accidentally deleted their working container ('project-x-dev'), but the anonymous volume containing their unsaved work still exists as a dangling volume. Your task is to locate this orphaned volume and restore access to the data.

1. Identify the dangling volume that contains the file 'PROJECT_X_BLUEPRINT.md' in its root directory. There are several decoy volumes, so you will need to inspect them.
2. Create and start a new container named 'recovery-env' (using any base image like alpine or ubuntu).
3. Mount the identified volume to '/workspace' inside the 'recovery-env' container.
4. Ensure the container keeps running so the developer can access the files.
